node.title: Re^3: How to read the input directory from command line arguments using perl?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
My query is this script is here where are you taking project.txt as your input in the above code.

Why while is empty without considering and input file? ([id://1185539|source])

You can read about the magic <> operator and its use in while loops in [doc://perlop#I/O-Operators]. In the code that [bart] posted, you would provide project.txt either on the command line, as in "perl script.pl project.txt", or by feeding it into the script's STDIN, as in "cat project.txt | perl script.pl".
